description: Beat the Bot: fight SWAPNUTZ, GT's paper sniper, on a live pump.fun launch. action "state" lists open rounds, the bot's live P&L and the rules. action "in" enters a round (round = the coin mint, size_sol, optional tp_pct / sl_pct / hold_s for an auto exit); action "out" exits. Orders are stamped on arrival and fill on GT's captured curve, same fees as the bot. action "session" reads a result. Paper only. Not financial advice.
